description: Search scholarly papers by keywords. Returns title, authors, year, venue, citation count, DOI, a one line abstract and a free to read link when one exists. A showing line under the heading says which results are on this page and how many matched in all, with the page to ask for next, so a long list can be read a page at a time. The results can be ordered, so you can get the most cited papers on a topic or the newest ones, and they can be limited to one kind of paper, to a range of years, to a minimum number of citations or to papers whose title carries the search words. Inputs: query (required keywords), from_year (optional earliest publication year), to_year (optional latest publication year), min_citations (optional, keep only the papers with at least this many citations), open_access_only (optional, false by default), title_only (optional, false by default, keep only the papers whose title carries the search words), type (optional, journal_article, preprint or book_chapter), sort (optional, relevance for the OpenAlex order, cited_by_count:desc for the most cited papers first, or publication_date:desc for the newest papers first), page (optional, which page of results to show, 1 to 400, 1 by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'find the most cited papers on spaced repetition since 2020.'

from_year.description: Only papers published in or after this year.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25.

min_citations.description: Only papers with at least this many citations.

open_access_only.description: Only papers with a free to read copy.

page.description: Which page of results to show, 1 to 400, 1 by default. Pass the page the showing line names to read the next page.

query.description: Keywords, for example: spaced repetition exam performance.

sort.description: How to order the results. relevance is the OpenAlex order, cited_by_count:desc puts the most cited papers first, publication_date:desc puts the newest papers first.

title_only.description: Only papers with the search words in the title, not just somewhere in the paper.

to_year.description: Only papers published in or before this year.

type.description: Keep only one kind of paper: journal_article, preprint or book_chapter.

name: search_papers
title: Search papers
